description: This file implements operations on google.protobuf.Timestamp, including validation, conversion from proto to time.Time, and conversion from time.Time to proto.

methods.name: validateTimestamp
methods.description: Validates a protobuf Timestamp ensuring it falls within valid range and has proper nanoseconds.

methods.name: timestampFromProto
methods.description: Converts a protobuf Timestamp to a Go time.Time, returning an error if invalid.

methods.name: timestampProto
methods.description: Converts a Go time.Time to a protobuf Timestamp, returning an error if invalid.
